description: Texts in an accordion beside a card of specs.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The details of a product under its buy box: texts in an accordion (native details) beside a card with the
  specs. Axes: layout (split: the specs beside the texts, stacked: below them), expand (first: the first text
  open, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Detail, Spec, ProductInfoLabels } from "./product-info.types";

  export type ProductInfoProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    details: Detail[];
    specs: Spec[];
    labels: ProductInfoLabels;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    expand?: "first" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Disclosure from "../compose/Disclosure.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Summary from "../compose/Summary.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    details,
    specs,
    labels,
    layout = "split",
    expand = "first",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ProductInfoProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={
      (layout as string) === "split" ? "grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3"
      : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8"
    }
  >
    {#if ((details?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
      <Stack
        gap="0"
        align="stretch"
        class={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "lg:col-span-2" : "")}
        data-slot="items"
      >
        {#each details as d, i (d.id)}
          <Disclosure variant="item" open={(((expand as string) === "first") && (i === 0))} data-slot="item">
            <Summary variant="item">
              <Inline class="text-base font-semibold">
                {d.title}
              </Inline>
            </Summary>
            <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
              {d.text}
            </Text>
          </Disclosure>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
    {#if ((specs?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-slot="specs">
        <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
          {labels.specs}
        </Title>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
          {#each specs as s (s.id)}
            <ListItem
              class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-2 text-sm last:border-b-0"
              data-slot="spec"
            >
              <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
                {s.label}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="font-medium">
                {s.value}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
